SELECT d.usage_date AS usageDate, ROUND(SUM(d.total_usage), 1) AS totalUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.peak_usage), 1) AS peakUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.high_usage), 1) AS highUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.flat_usage), 1) AS flatUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.valley_usage), 1) AS valleyUsage FROM electricity_daily_usage d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.usage_date >= DATE_SUB( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(usage_date), CURDATE()) FROM electricity_daily_usage WHERE deleted = 0), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY d.usage_date ORDER BY d.usage_date ASC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(d.total_usage), 1) AS totalUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.total_usage) / #{days}, 1) AS avgDaily, ROUND(MAX(d.total_usage), 1) AS maxDaily, COUNT(DISTINCT d.usage_date) AS dayCount, MIN(d.usage_date) AS fromDate, MAX(d.usage_date) AS toDate FROM electricity_daily_usage d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.usage_date >= DATE_SUB( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(usage_date), CURDATE()) FROM electricity_daily_usage WHERE deleted = 0), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(d.peak_usage), 1) AS peakUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.high_usage), 1) AS highUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.flat_usage), 1) AS flatUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.valley_usage), 1) AS valleyUsage, ROUND(SUM(d.total_usage), 1) AS totalUsage FROM electricity_daily_usage d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.usage_date >= DATE_SUB( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(usage_date), CURDATE()) FROM electricity_daily_usage WHERE deleted = 0), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.usage_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(d.total_usage), 1) AS totalUsage FROM electricity_daily_usage d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND d.usage_date >= DATE_SUB( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(usage_date), CURDATE()) FROM electricity_daily_usage WHERE deleted = 0), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.usage_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electricity_daily_usage WHERE usage_date = #{usageDate} AND deleted = 0
